purpose: Test restricted definitive signature-mismatch carry against unchanged production symbol_validate; reject broad contradiction carry.
prior_outcome_disclosure: Designed after inspecting completed real-structural-replay-v1. Same-cohort results are post-hoc exploratory sensitivity, not confirmatory preregistered evidence.
authorization: This task stages design and authored fixtures only. No new corpus access or sensitivity execution authorized by this draft.

fixed_population.allowed_commit_ids: Exactly the existing sealed real replay protocol groups; no new revisions, branches, sources, repositories or held-out data.

comparison_variants: research signature_mismatch_negative_carry with original symbol-anchor provenance
optional_conservative_comparator: Full-module identity negative carry, only if implemented and sealed before any new run; otherwise omit explicitly before freeze.
eligibility: Design.md exact proposed eligibility; sole previously_unavailable reason; prior actual contradicted/predicate_mismatch; signature_equals only; existing exact regular readable unambiguous function; unchanged AST + full normalized signature; immutable sealed context; complete provenance assumption.
state_transition: Call existing advance_state on effective selection; never synthesize validation, change last_checked_commit or make carried contradiction available.
anti_leakage: Independent reference and all_validate comparison never feed adapter or maintained state. Every variant uses own sequential states. Baseline states/results cannot substitute for candidate state evolution.
known_opportunity: Seven baseline sole-previously_unavailable retries, after the fifth child changed one signature. This is a retrospective count, not a predicted realized saving.
primary_endpoints: Number and fraction of original selected validations actually suppressed
Per-step candidate availability vs fresh all_validate; false availability and withheld-supported separately
Fresh production noncontradicted verdict on a suppressed step (supported and insufficient_evidence separately)
Mismatch of carried contradiction reason against fresh production reason
Recovery delay in number of revisions after first fresh-supported observation
secondary_endpoints: Logical selected validations, actual validate_claim executions, index work and adapter witness work separately
Number of suppressions by group, claim and reason; dependent observations disclosed
Parent initialization costs, reference costs and shared index costs separately
failure_rules: Any suppressed fresh-supported or fresh-insufficient-evidence result refutes the negative-preservation hypothesis on that case; preserve failed run and inspect before any new version.
Do not drop absent/uncertain/difficult steps, replace claims or trajectories, rewrite old results or silently weaken endpoint definitions.
Changed protocol/seal/context, warm/fresh index mismatch, malformed identity or unsupported access stops execution.
A zero reduction is a valid result. No wall-time benefit claim from reduced validation call counts.
Zero reference-contradicted denominators produce null rates with reason; no universal safety inference.
artifact_requirements: All original/effective selections, suppression eligibility and rejection reasons, claim/provenance/context hashes, previous/current states, last actual validation and actual new validation, exact source/index witness identity
Fresh full-production comparison and independent reference per scored observation, without feeding selection
Complete candidate/exclusion denominators and aggregate plus group-specific results
Separate costs, before/after source snapshots, new-only output directory, running/failed/complete manifest and artifact inventory

prospective_authored_matrix.status: Proposed to freeze generator source/seed/case manifest before expanded execution; existing eight design tests remain disclosed exploratory checks.
cross_product_axes: Prior state: supported, predicate_mismatch, subject_absent, uncertain
Mutation: unchanged, unrelated-file, unrelated-module-statement, signature default/annotation/decorator/async, body-only change, deletion, rename, recovery
Binding context: plain, duplicate, conditional, module rebinding, wildcard import, class/global/nested class
Evidence envelope: regular, executable regular, same-blob symlink, ancestor symlink/submodule, parse error, encoding error, size/LFS limitation
Provenance: complete research assumption, known incomplete, unresolved remarks, explicit dependency, changed provenance
Index path: fresh and warmed cache; same blob and changed mode
Direct and nested class/global contexts with same subject AST plus changed module ambiguity
Scope flags and same-ID expected-signature edits; roots/version/Python/size-limit context edits; mismatched prior validation input identity
negative_controls: Broad filter ancestor-symlink absence counterexample must fail negative-preservation check
Suppressed genuine subject-change marker must be detected by explicit AST/signature witness check
Ignoring signature witness during changed expected predicate must be caught by immutable-context gate
proof_obligations: Establish witness availability and unique same node kind in both indexes
Establish full-signature inequality preservation under immutable expectation
Prove unavailable and historical-check fields remain unchanged on omitted validation
Induct over actual sequential adjacent snapshots; retry all uncertainty and invalidated witnesses
Establish immediate recovery validation and no reference leakage
prospective_authored_matrix.limits: Finite authored tests and a conditional proof are not a formal proof of all Python bindings or independent truth.

implementation_next_gate: No further adapter expansion until the root chooses a candidate and freezes total-maintenance-cost measurement; see timing-and-context-plan.md.
cost_hypothesis: Reduced validate_claim call counts may be cosmetic; compare full maintenance cost including eligibility/witness acquisition, and reject performance claim if no robust reduction.
planned_context_binding: Immutable prior actual-mismatch witness binds full claim/provenance/context hashes, actual result input identity and full regular subject module identity; same-ID predicate/context edits must retry or reject.
superseded_by: challenge-protocol.json: bounded 17 authored histories only; no real-cohort sensitivity authorized or implemented.
